study: Per-formula coefficient refit: local analogue of paper Table 3
writers: Four frozen Qwen3.5-9B historical-context screen winners; all four retained
component_basis: phi_j = (saved full output - saved drop-j output) / original effective coefficient a_j
fit_split: Reuse exact saved claim-grouped 5606 fit / 1401 validation indices; no outer-validation refit
C_selection: maximum mean directed AUROC of three StratifiedGroupKFold folds, shuffle=True, random_state=441, on fit rows only; earlier grid value wins ties
scaler: StandardScaler fitted separately within each CV fold and on fit rows for final model
final_metric: Both directed and per-dataset max(AUC,100-AUC), equal nine-dataset mean; train/validation directed only
evolution_reference: Saved actual full-program scores, not reconstructed score, retained as primary Evo rows
precision_guard: Reconstructed Evo score versus frozen scores: max absolute score error <= 1e-3 and AUROC error <= .001 percentage points for every training/validation/test set. Exported component differences preserve float32 cancellation; not exact algebraic feature extraction.
coefficient_comparison: Original effective weights versus logistic raw-input weights (beta_standardized / scale); also z-scale vectors and positive-L1-normalized weights; do not correlate two-entry vectors
limitations: New post-benchmark exploratory CPU follow-up, not result from previous GPU campaign
Candidate pool is validation-informed; outer validation is diagnostic
Same per-formula feature definitions; no 12-column pooling or unconditional extra NLL column
Inherited generated programs may already use rows now in grouped outer validation during discovery
Existing nine test sets already viewed; no confirmatory/SOTA interpretation
Reported weights depend on units, regularization, precision and correlated features
